rewrites.name: case_true_metamorphic
rewrites.template: CASE WHEN true THEN {e} ELSE 0 END
rewrites.why: CASE with a constant TRUE condition simplifies to its branch, which must preserve its typmod and collation.

rewrites.name: nullif_null_metamorphic
rewrites.why: NULLIF with a constant NULL second argument reduces to the first argument while preserving collation metadata.
